updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer version and lets you know. Nothing is ever installed automatically.
updates.auto: Check for a new version at startup

apiServer.title: API server
apiServer.hint: Offers OpenAI- and VOICEVOX-compatible APIs to other apps.

storage.title: Storage folder
storage.hint: Everything the app keeps — models, the runtime, voices, history, projects — lives in this folder.

move.title: Move the storage folder
move.hint: Copies the data to another folder or drive, checks the copy, then switches to it. The old folder stays until you delete it.
move.pickTitle: Choose the new storage folder (an empty folder)
move.proposed: The chosen folder is not empty, so a new folder will be created inside it.

notes.stop: The app cannot be used during the move. Running and queued work is cancelled.
notes.caches: The download cache (uv) and bytecode are not copied; they are rebuilt when needed.
notes.keep: The app switches only after checking the copy. The old folder stays, so you can delete it later.

move.queueBusy: Generations are running or queued. Starting the move cancels them.
move.keepOpen: Keep the app open until the move finishes.

result.done: The storage folder has been moved.
result.failed: The storage folder could not be moved. The app runs from the old folder.
result.cancelled: The move was cancelled. The app still uses the old folder.
result.oldRoot: The old folder is still there: {{path}}
result.deleteConfirm: {{path}} will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

model.title: Model
model.hint: Loaded at startup and kept in memory.

runtime.title: Device and precision (advanced)
runtime.hint: Overrides the device and precision chosen during setup. Applying restarts the engine, which loads the model again.
runtime.restartNote: Nothing can be generated during the restart. Running and queued work is cancelled.
runtime.cpuOnly: This installation was set up for the CPU, so the GPU cannot be used.

repair.title: Repair the installation
repair.hint: Checks the dependencies and model files and reinstalls anything missing or damaged. Use it when the app does not start or the model fails to load.
repair.confirm: The engine stops and setup runs the repair. Checking the model files takes a few minutes, and damaged files are downloaded again (this needs an internet connection).

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.hint: Embeds an inaudible watermark (SilentCipher) in generated audio, so that it can later be identified as AI-generated.
watermark.offNote: Audio is generated without a watermark. When you publish it, state clearly that it is AI-generated.

output.title: Export defaults
output.hint: The format and post-processing used for saving and exporting — the same settings as on each screen.

logs.title: Logs
logs.hint: Useful when something goes wrong; please include them when you report a problem.

about.license: This app is released under the MIT License. It is not the official Irodori-TTS app.
about.componentsHint: The licenses of the models and software this app uses.
about.name: Name
about.pythonHint: The packages installed in the engine's runtime and the licenses their metadata names.
